finding: The official release-management article links a genuine repository-specific Marketplace action publication flow that is absent from the inventory: action.yml banner → Draft a release, Publish this Action checkbox, metadata validation, primary/secondary category controls, and unpublishing per release.
recommended_fix: Add a conditional release/Actions Marketplace publication component or expand C085. Include public repository/root action metadata, unique name, developer-agreement checkbox gate and 2FA; mark external Marketplace listing as a boundary. This is a release form, not a Settings form.

location: 05-data-and-state-model.md: Alert / finding object and Security finding state dimension
finding: One normalized alert state is insufficient for code-scanning branch/configuration occurrence states. The detail header always reflects the default branch; nondefault-only alerts show in branch/in pull request, and different configurations can disagree because scans are stale.
recommended_fix: Add alert occurrence identity (alert + branch + analysis configuration), last analysis time and raw occurrence state. Keep default-branch presentation state separate from source-specific overall resolution. Refer to A079 rather than assuming every finding belongs to one revision.

location: 05-data-and-state-model.md: Alert / finding, Repository capability and minimum fixtures
finding: Secret validity active/inactive/unknown is independent of open/closed resolution, and assigning a secret alert can temporarily grant an otherwise unauthorized writer access to only that alert. A repository-wide alert-read capability cannot express this object-specific grant or its revocation.
recommended_fix: Add validity to secret subtype and object-scoped alert access/assignment lifecycle. Include assigned-secret-viewer → unassigned-access-revoked fixture; link validity semantics to A088 and assignment semantics to A115.

finding: The proposed model should explicitly allow an environment-referencing Actions job to wait for review/timer without having a deployment object. Current environment deployment:false behavior preserves these gates and omits deployment history; a custom protection app fails without a deployment record.
recommended_fix: Make deployment relation optional on an environment approval and keep wait reason/gate type on job context. Add one environment-only waiting fixture and distinguish custom-app incompatibility failure from reviewer rejection.

location: 05-data-and-state-model.md: Artifact / cache and Package / version; cross-feature relationships
finding: New linked-artifact storage/deployment metadata is a distinct entity family: organization Packages → Linked artifacts hosts metadata only, can describe external registries, and its deployment records do not come from the repository deployment dashboard.
recommended_fix: Add provenance attestation and linked artifact storage/deployment record objects, retaining source-system identity. Keep optional references to workflow artifact/package version/source repo and never union repository deployment events with runtime metadata merely because their environment names match.

finding: The proposed linear Commit → attempt → checks → artifact/deployment chain can imply a check creates artifacts or proves a deployment. Actions workflow run produces a suite, each job a check run, artifacts are run-linked outputs, and deployments can be independently created.
recommended_fix: Describe a branched lineage: commit → run/attempt → jobs/checks, with separate artifact/deployment links supported by provenance. Preserve independent legacy status contexts and third-party checks; unknown links remain missing.

finding: Reliability/Maintainability ratings are worst-finding-severity categories, not continuous numeric measurements. A trend panel should not imply a small severity-count change is a measured improvement in a universal quality score.
recommended_fix: Show categorical rating and underlying rule/severity counts with comparable analysis coverage and revision, retaining Standard findings vs recent-merge AI findings distinctions. Require uploaded line-coverage baseline freshness when showing coverage delta.
